title: Dignity
desc: Dignity will bring to the screen the conflict between two diametrically opposed families and an impossible love that blossoms in the midst of this conflict. Doğukan Güngör will appear as Mehmet, a young man from the neighborhood who possesses goals and ideals yet refuses to compromise his principles, no matter the circumstances. The character’s greatest test will be the difficult choice he must make between his love and his honor.
